20261122-chemistry-g12-1.title: Colligative properties dzepamusoro dze solutions
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Colligative properties dzepamusoro dze solutions kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.material: [Colligative properties dzepamusoro dze solutions] Ndeipi sarudzo ine zvirevo zvose zvakarurama chete pamusoro pehunhu (colligative properties) hwe dilute solution ine nonvolatile, nonelectrolyte solute? (i) Zvinoenderana nenhamba chete yema solute particles (molality), pasina hunhu hwerudzi rwe solute. (ii) Vapor pressure inodzikiswa uye boiling point inokwidziridzwa kana tichienzanisa ne pure solvent. (iii) Fomula yaVan 't Hoff ye osmotic pressure, Π = cRT, yakafanana ne ideal gas equation of state.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: [Colligative properties dzepamusoro dze solutions] Ndeipi sarudzo ine zvirevo zvose zvakarurama chete pamusoro pehunhu (colligative properties) hwe dilute solution ine nonvolatile, nonelectrolyte solute? (iii) Fomula yaVan 't Hoff ye osmotic pressure, Π = cRT, yakafanana ne ideal gas equation of state.
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.explain: Ma colligative properties e solution anoenderana nenhamba yema particles chete, pasina hunhu hwemakemikari e solute, uye anosanganisira vapor pressure lowering, boiling point elevation, freezing point depression, ne osmotic pressure ($\Pi = cRT$), saka (i), (ii), ne (iii) zvose zvakarurama.

20261122-chemistry-g12-2.title: inozadza airbag mukati me 0
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye inozadza airbag mukati me 0 kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.material: Equation yekuparadzaniswa kwe solid sodium azide (NaN₃), inozadza airbag mukati me 0.03 seconds mukuitika kwengozi yemotokari, ndi 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Chii chikonzero chemakemikari chakanakisa nei reaction iyi ichishandiswa kugadzira gasi re airbag?
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.prompt: Equation yekuparadzaniswa kwe solid sodium azide (NaN₃), inozadza airbag mukati me 0.03 seconds mukuitika kwengozi yemotokari, ndi 2NaN₃(s) → 2Na(s) + 3N₂(g). Chii chikonzero chemakemikari chakanakisa nei reaction iyi ichishandiswa kugadzira gasi re airbag?
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.explain: Nespark yemagetsi, sodium azide inoparadzaniswa nekukasira uye ichigadzira gasi renitrojeni rakawanda ($\text{N}_2$), risina njodzi kumuviri wemunhu uye risingapindure makemikari, richichengetedza vagari mumotokari zvakanaka panguva yengozi.
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.hint.0: Gasi renitrojeni (N₂) rinoumba 78% yemweya uye harina njodzi kumuviri wemunhu uye harisvinure.
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.hint.1: 2 mol ye solid inowedzera nekukasira kuita 3 mol yegasi.
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.o.o0: Solid shoma inopindura ichigadzira gasi rakawanda rakachengeteka, rakagadzikana, inert re nitrojeni (N₂) nekukasira kunoputika
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.o.o1: Inogadzira gasi re kroriini ine chepfu rinonatsa mweya
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.o.o2: Reaction inotonhora kusvika pa 50 degrees pasi pezero
20261122-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.o.o3: Hapana gasi rinogadzirwa uye inoitika sponge yakasimba
